proposal.summary: SolarWinds MSP Patch Management Engine (PME) Cache Service before 1.1.15 has insecure file permissions on CacheService.xml allowing non-privileged users to modify SISServerURL to point to an attacker-controlled server, resulting in download and execution of a malicious executable as SYSTEM.
proposal.affected_product: SolarWinds MSP PME (Patch Management Engine) before 1.1.15
proposal.cwe_quote: The XML file CacheService.xml in %PROGRAMDATA%\SolarWinds MSP\SolarWinds.MSP.CacheService\config\ is writable by normal users, so that the parameter SISServerURL can be changed, which controls the location of the updates.

AV.quote: After restarting the system or reloading the CacheService.xml, the service connects to the web server controlled by the attacker and downloads the executable file.

PR.quote: Any user on the system who is in group users can change the file content.

C.quote: After a certain time the executable file is executed by SolarWinds MSP RPC Server service and establishes a connection with the rights of the system user to the attacker.

I.quote: After a certain time the executable file is executed by SolarWinds MSP RPC Server service and establishes a connection with the rights of the system user to the attacker.

A.quote: After a certain time the executable file is executed by SolarWinds MSP RPC Server service and establishes a connection with the rights of the system user to the attacker.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate installations for the vulnerable PME version, check integrity and permissions of CacheService.xml on affected hosts, remove any attacker-controlled files from cache and archives, rotate credentials and investigate for signs of SYSTEM-level compromise; apply vendor patch PME 1.1.15.
